build_SNConv2d_layer: build a spectral normalization Conv2d layer with configurable power iterations and singular value count
create_GBlock_generator: create a generator residual block with batchnorm, convolution, and optional upsampling for BigGAN
create_DBlock_discriminator: create a discriminator residual block with spectral norm convolutions and optional downsampling
build_ccbn_layer: build a class-conditional batchnorm layer with linear gain and bias from class embeddings
run_power_iteration: run power iteration to estimate top N singular values of a weight matrix
